items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, I don't mean Louis James, um... This other clarinet player that Dumaine had.

ctx.x: No problem. But he was known as a pretty good clarinet player in the 20s. Yeah. Yeah. Did you ever hear of this boy, um... Oh, I don't mean Louis James, um... This other clarinet player that Dumaine had. Kaiser? Oh, well, no, I was thinking of Willie Joseph. Well, that's Kaiser.
